title: Content Detection and Encoding System
description: This cluster comprises a suite of Java classes and interfaces for content type detection and character encoding. Components include `DefaultProbDetector`, `ProbabilisticMimeDetectionSelector`, `OverrideDetector`, `CompositeDetector`, `TextDetector`, `NNExampleModelDetector`, and `AutoDetectReader`. These components work together to detect MIME types and character encodings using probabilistic, rule-based, and machine learning approaches. The system supports dynamic loading of detectors and encoders, ensuring flexibility and extensibility. Quality attributes include high accuracy, performance optimization through bounded input streams, and robust error handling. Technologies used include Java, Apache Tika, and neural network models.

title: File Type Detection System
description: The File Type Detection System consists of two main components: `MagicMatch` and `MagicDetector`. `MagicMatch` defines and evaluates magic matches for file type detection, initializing with media type, type, offset, value, and mask. It uses lazy initialization for `MagicDetector` to ensure thread safety and efficiency. `MagicDetector` performs the actual pattern matching, comparing predefined byte patterns against an input stream to determine the media type. This system supports scalability through lazy initialization and thread synchronization, and enhances security by accurately identifying file types. Technology Used: Java, Apache Tika.

description: This cluster comprises components that facilitate the parsing and management of content using Apache Tika. Quality attributes include robustness, configurability, and security. Technologies used include Java, Apache Tika, and optional Jackson for JSON deserialization.

title: Apache Tika Parsing and Metadata Management Cluster
description: This cluster comprises a suite of classes and interfaces that facilitate the parsing, detection, and management of metadata for various document types. The components work together to handle content extraction, encoding detection, metadata filtering, and security measures. The `DefaultParser` and `AutoDetectParser` classes dynamically load and use multiple parsers to handle different media types, ensuring flexibility and extensibility. The `Metadata` class manages metadata attributes, while `EncodingDetector` and `LanguageDetector` handle character encoding and language detection, respectively. Security is enforced through classes like `SecureContentHandler` and `OutputLimits`, which prevent denial of service attacks and manage output limits. The cluster supports non-functional requirements such as scalability, security, and configurability. Technologies used include Java, Apache Tika, and the SAX API.

title: Content Parsing and Resource Management System
description: This cluster comprises a suite of Java classes and interfaces for managing temporary resources and parsing content. `TemporaryResources` handles the creation and automatic deletion of temporary files, ensuring efficient resource management. `ContentHandlerFactory` provides a factory interface for generating content handlers, facilitating content extraction. `ParserUtils` offers utility methods for metadata handling and parser information, enhancing the robustness of content processing. `AbstractMultipleParser` and `SupplementingParser` enable the use of multiple parsers to process input streams, merging results and handling metadata conflicts. The system achieves scalability and reliability through modular design and efficient resource handling. Technology Used: Java, Apache Tika.
